knobs.note: 1 claims the fix rounds blocked-resolver queued for this box and runs each one detached (BH-2530). 0 claims nothing: a queued row waits, and a claimed one is re-offered after the stale cutoff.

Claim requests one tick may make, lost races included. Each claimed row starts one detached fix round, which holds this box for up to BR_FIX_LANE_TIMEOUT. The stale cutoff sent with each claim is ceil((BR_FIX_LANE_TIMEOUT + BR_FIX_HOP_MARGIN) / 60) minutes, read from the blocked-resolver knobs.

Test seam: 1 runs each claimed round in the foreground so tests/fix-round-claim.bh-2530-test.sh can assert its outcome. NOT settable from the control plane; production leaves it 0, and the tick never waits on a round.
